# Tech stack icons

The `ic_tech_*.xml` vector paths are adapted from [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/90646e4bf7f3b89df6c37e65baf3e7bc759a517c/icons), under CC0 1.0 (included in `simple-icons-CC0.txt`). They are bundled native Android vectors; no icon service is contacted at runtime. Colors and rounded tile backgrounds belong to this app's presentation.

The authored `skillicons.dev` lists in a public profile README determine stack and learning membership. Unsupported IDs use readable text rather than another product's logo. These tiles identify technologies and do not imply endorsement.
